game.title: Dice sum
game.description:
Three dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (6 faces, each equally likely): 0, 4, 5, 8, 11, 12.
- Die 2 (6 faces, each equally likely): 2, 3, 3, 8, 9, 11.
- Die 3 (6 faces, each equally likely): 0, 2, 3, 3, 3, 7.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of all the dice.

game.title: Dice sum
game.description:
Four dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (4 faces, each equally likely): 3, 4, 6, 10.
- Die 2 (6 faces, each equally likely): 0, 1, 5, 9, 11, 11.
- Die 3 (8 faces, each equally likely): 0, 1, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 10.
- Die 4 (4 faces, each equally likely): 0, 1, 4, 11.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of all the dice.

game.title: Dice sum
game.description:
Two dice are rolled independently. Repeated numbers are separate faces.
- Die 1 (4 faces, each equally likely): 0, 3, 11, 12.
- Die 2 (8 faces, each equally likely): 1, 2, 7, 7, 9, 11, 11, 11.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of all the dice.

game.title: Card sum
game.description: A custom deck of 13 cards is shuffled: 4 cards worth 1, 2 cards worth 2, 4 cards worth 4, 2 cards worth 14, 1 card worth 15. 2 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of the dealt cards' values.

game.title: Card sum
game.description: A custom deck of 21 cards is shuffled: 3 cards worth 2, 3 cards worth 3, 4 cards worth 5, 4 cards worth 6, 4 cards worth 7, 2 cards worth 8, 1 card worth 11. 3 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of the dealt cards' values.

game.title: Card sum
game.description: A custom deck of 11 cards is shuffled: 2 cards worth 2, 3 cards worth 4, 1 card worth 10, 3 cards worth 12, 2 cards worth 15. 3 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the sum of the dealt cards' values.

game.title: Dice/cards product
game.description: A custom deck of 12 cards is shuffled: 2 cards worth 0, 1 card worth 2, 4 cards worth 3, 4 cards worth 5, 1 card worth 13. 2 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the product of the dealt cards.

game.title: Dice/cards max
game.description: A custom deck of 17 cards is shuffled: 2 cards worth 0, 4 cards worth 2, 3 cards worth 6, 1 card worth 8, 1 card worth 9, 3 cards worth 10, 3 cards worth 13. 2 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the largest of the dealt cards.

game.title: Dice/cards min
game.description: A custom deck of 8 cards is shuffled: 2 cards worth 2, 1 card worth 6, 1 card worth 8, 1 card worth 10, 1 card worth 11, 2 cards worth 12. 3 cards are dealt face down, without replacement.
game.contract: The contract settles at the smallest of the dealt cards.

game.title: Coin of unknown bias
game.description: A coin is picked at random from a set of coins: P(heads) = 0.2 with probability 2/5, P(heads) = 0.5 with probability 1/5, P(heads) = 0.9 with probability 2/5. The coin is not shown. It is flipped 6 times. Revealed flips show 1 for heads and 0 for tails.
game.contract: The contract settles at 5 times the number of heads in all flips.

game.title: Coin of unknown bias
game.description: A coin is picked at random from a set of coins: P(heads) = 0.4 with probability 2/5, P(heads) = 0.6 with probability 2/5, P(heads) = 0.8 with probability 1/5. The coin is not shown. It is flipped 5 times. Revealed flips show 1 for heads and 0 for tails.
game.contract: The contract settles at the number of heads in all flips.

game.title: Coin of unknown bias
game.description: A coin is picked at random from a set of coins: P(heads) = 0.2 with probability 3/5, P(heads) = 0.3 with probability 2/5. The coin is not shown. It is flipped 7 times. Revealed flips show 1 for heads and 0 for tails.
game.contract: The contract settles at the number of heads in all flips.

game.title: Urn of unknown mix
game.description: An urn holds 11 balls, each red or blue. Each ball was independently painted red with probability 0.6. 4 balls are drawn without replacement. Revealed draws show 1 for red and 0 for blue.
game.contract: The contract settles at 10 times the number of red balls originally in the urn.

game.title: Urn of unknown mix
game.description: An urn holds 9 balls, each red or blue. The number of red balls is equally likely to be any of 0, 1, ..., 9. 2 balls are drawn without replacement. Revealed draws show 1 for red and 0 for blue.
game.contract: The contract settles at 10 times the number of red balls originally in the urn.

game.title: Urn of unknown mix
game.description: An urn holds 8 balls, each red or blue. Each ball was independently painted red with probability 0.6. 3 balls are drawn without replacement. Revealed draws show 1 for red and 0 for blue.
game.contract: The contract settles at the number of red balls originally in the urn.
